summary.intent: Act as lead session for Callisto v1 alpha: launch and monitor background sessions, track work packages in the plan file, coordinate PR merge order and rebases, and escalate to the user only for merge-ready PRs or credentials. Later, the user pushed to get fixes and review findings on PRs #242/#634 and #246/#638 resolved.
summary.outcome: Sessions were coordinated and PR #560 (WP A) merged, which unblocked the others. Findings on changes 169 and 173 were fixed and resolved. #634 and #638 went through several review rounds and were pushed with findings resolved or dismissed. The v1 alpha work packages had not all merged, and `just verify-real` had not run.

repo: RUSTSEC-2026-0542 (humantime unmaintained, via dev-dep trycmd) fails the cargo-deny audit on every PR until deny.toml ignores it; WP A's #560 carries that fix, so other PRs must rebase after it merges.
The launch rules forbid `Claude-Session:` trailers and no-stack branches; commits must be signed, and each WP diff needs cargo mutants run.
cargo-mutants output under `mutants.out.old/` was committed in PRs #565 and #567; .gitignore only covered `mutants.out/` and was widened to `mutants.out*/`.
`claude --bg --resume` needs the full session id, not the 8-char job id.
A plain `git push` can fail silently when the local branch name differs from its upstream; use an explicit refspec and verify with `git ls-remote`.
Entire trails group WPs by outcome (#357, #457-#460); sessions link branches with `entire trail link` and close findings with `entire trail finding resolve`.
#563 (WP I) conflicts with #560 in crates/callisto-cli/benches/commands.rs and shares walk.rs with #561, so it merges after E.
Two flaky tests were seen: registry_version_the_registry_serves_is_exact_with_no_checksum_or_yank_claim and init::tests::an_existing_config_errors.

code.finding: Prompt hint selection: marked rows give 'Enter keeps the * ones', empty_ok gives 'Enter picks none', otherwise 'Type numbers...'. An empty line returns [] and becomes E273 in add.rs.

E120 shows only the scheme and host of the registry URL via ShownRegistry::new. The path is kept hidden on purpose because some registries put tokens in the path; the message now says which setting to compare.
E342 returned before the Changesets migration warnings were queued, so they were dropped. The migration diagnostics should be queued right after changesets::migrate.

workflow: The Entire trail gate needs a human reviewer approval, so a PR with green CI can still show a failing gate.
Passing a subagent review does not guarantee zero new findings; the user wanted the whole finding history swept against the current code before each push.
Verify a session's claims against the remote (`git ls-remote`, diff against main, signature check) before recording a PR as ready.
The user pushed back on over-explained UX; short hints and dropping the `#N` syntax were preferred over wordier edge-case documentation.

friction: The sandbox blocked the session daemon socket, so `claude agents` had to be run outside the sandbox.
Session 3 was blocked when the auto-mode classifier refused a commit that carried a forbidden Claude-Session trailer.
Session 2 sat at a worktree permission prompt that only the user could answer.
The first resume of Session 5 used the short id and silently failed.
I wrongly told the user that all PRs would go green after #560 merged. #563 still had a bench-file conflict.
Session 1's reported push of #567 never reached the remote because of the upstream-name mismatch.
Review rounds on #634 and #638 kept producing new low-severity findings; the user expressed frustration over repeated findings and days of effort.
Session 2 skipped cargo mutants on its final commits until asked.
Slow gates when two worktrees built in parallel.
open_items: Merge #562, #564, #566, #567, #568, #561, #565, #563 and #569 in wave order, with rebases after #560.
WP E's changeset needs a decision on whether it is Breaking; I recommended yes.
WPs G, H, K, L, M, Q and R, and Session 4's `just verify-real`, are not done; L waits for #565 to merge and #569 merges after L.
PR #645 (Git boundary, #253) was moved to draft and needs a redesign.
Interactive-CLI contract decisions remain: re-asking instead of E273 on empty input, and `TERM=dumb` never prompting.
E299 help still mentions `git remote add origin` instead of `get-url --push`.
Contrived collision edge cases in tty.rs (a package named like another's qualified id) were left unfixed.
The latest push of both PRs resolves new findings on #634 and #638; the reviewer will run again and may raise more.
